description: Land Title Settlement Department - Palliyagodella, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120063
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations for multiple land parcels in Palliyagodella. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status (primarily "The State"), and possession/license details. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
